headline: Prediction: Is Salesforce a Millionaire-Maker Stock?
summary: Salesforce stock has cratered over 38% this year while its AI business quietly explodes in the background, and the gap between those two realities is exactly where opportunity hides or evaporates.

headline: Salesforce (CRM) Lands $1.6 Billion VA Deal To Power Veteran Care
summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) has secured a US$1.6 billion, three-year contract with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs. The Missionforce platform will be used to modernize care and service delivery for more than 17 million veterans. The contract focuses on AI-powered workflows, 24/7 care coordination, and secure cloud tools across the VA system.
